title: Series
description: One monthly, area-weighted time series for a Region-Variable pair (DS-001).

values.description: One entry per Time step from period.start to period.end inclusive: per calendar month for the seed set and the Discovery engine, so index i is the month i after period.start. An Explore My World Series at a daily or 3-hourly Time step (#80) has one entry per UTC day or UTC 3-hour interval from the first day of period.start. A missing Time step is null rather than omitted, which keeps the index aligned with the calendar.

areaSeries.description: A Series for a Selected area (#79): the same fields as a Region's Series, with `area` where `region_id` would be. The Discovery engine never reads one.

quality.description: Result of the quality gate (BS-003). A series the gate excluded is still returned, flagged here, but its values are all null so nothing can use them.

included.description: False when the gate excludes this series from every Candidate Discovery.

missing_fraction.description: Share of Time steps (months for the seed set) in the period with no value. Above 0.2 the series is excluded.

valid_land_fraction.description: Share of the Region's cells that are valid land, for Variables with a land mask. Below 0.5 the series is excluded. Null for Variables without a land mask.

exclusions.description: Why the gate excluded the series. Empty when it was kept.
